name: Bento grid
description: Asymmetric mosaic of feature tiles with varying spans, subtle gradients, and a hover lift, in pure CSS.

name: Infinite marquee
description: Seamlessly looping chip track from a duplicated row and one CSS keyframe; pauses on hover, frozen for reduced-motion.

name: Statement / word reveal
description: Display sentence whose words fade and rise in sequence via staggered CSS delays, with a JS replay button.

name: Animated stat counters
description: Three figures that count up on first scroll into view via IntersectionObserver; final values live in the markup.

name: Sticky scroll-story
description: Two-column block with a pinned visual card that crossfades as a scroll-spy highlights the active step.

name: Before / after slider
description: Two stacked panels split by a draggable divider; a range input drives a CSS variable clip, keyboard-accessible.

name: Hover-reveal work list
description: Large project rows that highlight on hover while a gradient thumbnail follows the cursor; degrades without JS.
